```{r}
## Loading packages
library(pacman)
p_load(qualtRics, janitor, stargazer, pander, printy, emmeans, plotrix, 
       emmeans, lme4, clubSandwich, tidyverse)
```

```{r}
## Setting options for viewing summary tables
options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## Setting seed
set.seed(20231129)
```


```{r}
## Reading in raw data
se1 <- read_survey("SE1_Data.csv")
```

```{r}
## Cleaning
se1_clean <- se1 %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  filter(finished == 1,
         is.na(age) == FALSE, 
         is.na(imc) == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number(),
         policy = if_else(policy == "punishments", "punishment", "reward"),
         pr_con = case_when(policy == "punishment" ~ -1, policy == "reward" ~ 1),
         order = if_else(frame == "prevent", "prevent_first", "fix_first"),
         order_con = case_when(frame == "prevent" ~ -1, frame == "fix" ~ 1),
         pref_prev = rowMeans(across(c(rew_prev_1, rew_prev_2, pun_prev_1, 
                                       pun_prev_2)), na.rm = T),
         pref_fix = rowMeans(across(c(rew_fix_1, rew_fix_2, pun_fix_1, 
                                      pun_fix_2)), na.rm = T)) %>% 
  select(id, policy, pr_con, order, order_con, pref_prev, pref_fix, gender,
         age)
```

```{r}
se1_clean_long <- se1_clean %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(pref_prev, pref_fix),
               names_to = "frame",
               names_prefix = "pref_",
               values_to = "pref") %>% 
  mutate(pf_con = if_else(frame == "prev", -1, 1),
         frame = if_else(frame == "prev", "prevent", "fix")) %>% 
  select(id, policy, pr_con, order, order_con, frame, pf_con, pref,
         gender, age)
```


\clearpage

# Sample

```{r}
## Collecting descriptives
pct_male = round((sum(se1_clean$gender == 1)/nrow(se1_clean))*100, 2)
pct_female = round((sum(se1_clean$gender == 2)/nrow(se1_clean))*100, 2)
pct_nonbinary = round((sum(se1_clean$gender == 3)/nrow(se1_clean))*100, 2)
mean_age = round(mean(se1_clean$age), 2)
sd_age = round(sd(se1_clean$age), 2)
```


We aimed to recruit 600 U.S. MTurk participants via CloudResearch for this study.

Participants from the raw Qualtrics data were only included in this analysis if they completed the survey in its entirety and passed a preregistered attention check, leaving us with `r nrow(se1_clean)` participants (`r pct_female`% female, `r pct_male`% male, `r pct_nonbinary`% nonbinary; Mean~Age~ = `r mean_age`, SD~Age~ = `r sd_age`).

\clearpage

# Means

```{r}
## Collecting means using `emmeans` given the within-subjects nature of this
## experiment
as.data.frame(emmeans(lmer(pref ~ pf_con*pr_con + (1 | id), 
                           data = se1_clean_long), ~ pr_con * pf_con)) %>%
  mutate(Policy = if_else(pr_con == -1, "Punishment", "Reward"),
         Frame = if_else(pf_con == -1, "Prevent", "Fix"),
         Mean = round(emmean, 2),
         SE = round(SE, 2),
         "95% CI - Lower" = round(lower.CL, 2),
         "95% CI - Upper" = round(upper.CL, 2)) %>% 
  select(Policy, Frame, Mean, SE, "95% CI - Lower", "95% CI - Upper") %>%
  arrange(Policy) %>% 
  pander("Means by Policy, Frame (Note that 0 = FP and 1 = FN)")
```

\clearpage

# Primary Regression Results

Below we conduct a mixed effects logistic regression of policy (-1 = Punishments; 1 = Rewards), frame (-1 = Prevent; 1 = Fix), and their interaction upon preferences (0 = FP; 1 = FN) with random intercepts by participant.

```{r}
## Regression
m1 <- glmer(pref ~ pf_con*pr_con + (1 | id), data = se1_clean_long, family = binomial)
```

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Main results
summary(m1)

## 95% CIs
confint(m1, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")
```

```{r}
## Collecting more details on the coefficient of interest
ixn_or <- round(exp(coef(summary(m1))[4]), 2)
```

We are primarily interested in the interaction, and the odds ratio for this term (which we will use as a measure of effect size) is `r ixn_or`.

\clearpage

# Secondary Regression Results

For completeness we will also run the same regression looking for a three-way policy-frame-order interaction.

```{r}
## Regression
m2 <- glmer(pref ~ pf_con*pr_con*order_con + (1 | id), data = se1_clean_long, 
            family = binomial)
```

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Main results
summary(m2)

## 95% CIs
confint(m2, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")
```

```{r}
## Collecting more details on the coefficient of interest
ixn_or2 <- round(exp(coef(summary(m2))[8]), 2)
```

We are primarily interested in the interaction, and the odds ratio for this term (which we will use as a measure of effect size) is `r ixn_or2`.

\clearpage

# Simple Effects

## Punishments

```{r}
## Results within Punishments
simple_pun <- glmer(pref ~ pf_con + (1 | id), 
                    data = filter(se1_clean_long, pr_con == -1),
                    family = binomial)
```

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Main results
summary(simple_pun)

## 95% CIs
confint(simple_pun, method = "Wald", parm = "beta_")

## Odds Ratio
round(exp(coef(summary(simple_pun))[2]), 2)
```

\clearpage

## Rewards

```{r}
## Results within Punishments
simple_rew <- glmer(pref ~ pf_con + (1 | id), 
                    data = filter(se1_clean_long, pr_con == 1), 
                    family = binomial)
```

```{r, results = TRUE, echo = TRUE}
## Main results
```
